answer: A sybil-resistant market can use falcon patrols: fast, randomly assigned auditors swoop in on a small share of completed jobs and re-run them, leaving an indelible umber mark on a public ledger for each verdict. Every clean job sends a ripple of trust outward - clients and neighbours see the marks accumulate, so honest agents build visible streaks. A farm must pass the same audits for every fake identity, and one failed check stains all its linked identities umber at once. Honest agents pay one quick audit now and then; attackers pay a hundred audits and lose every streak at the first lie.
